tuitionNonEU: CRITICAL AND NEW. Décret n°2026-385 of 19 May 2026 (part of the 'Choose France for Higher Education' plan), effective 1 September 2026, changes how differentiated fees work at French PUBLIC UNIVERSITIES. Reference amounts (2025-2026 basis; 2026-2027 amounts 'not yet known' per service-public.gouv.fr): LICENCE €2,895/yr vs €178 standard; MASTER €3,941/yr vs €254 standard. EXEMPTION QUOTAS: universities may exempt at most 30% of their non-EU students in 2026-2027, 25% in 2027-2028 (THE CANDIDATE'S ENTRY YEAR), and 20% long-term. Previously universities exempted non-EU students en masse, making the regime largely theoretical; that is no longer safe to assume. Students already exempted keep the exemption to the end of their cycle. Exempt by right: EU/EEA/Swiss nationals, Canadians resident in Quebec, students enrolled since 2018/2019, doctoral students, holders of a French government scholarship (bourse du gouvernement français), refugees/subsidiary protection, legal French residents. A TUNISIAN IS NOT EXEMPT BY RIGHT. IMPORTANT: this regime targets universities; Ministry-of-Culture establishments (CNSMD Paris/Lyon, ENSATT, ENS Louis-Lumière, Le Fresnoy, écoles nationales supérieures d'art) charge their own low flat fees (€300–€760/yr observed) and no differentiated non-EU rate was found for them.
